hero-azalea:
this is all one cost 0 action that azalea can activate once per turn. 

on activation - popup: select card in arsenal - move card in arsenal to bottom of deck - move card on top of deck to arsenal (face down) - conditional extra effect - check if card in arsenal has type 'arrow' - if yes : add dominate - go again.
hero-blaze-firemind:
static ability - check log for opt - when opt is completed, for each card looked at - example opt 1 / opt 2 / opt 3 - add 1/2/3 energy counters to blaze.

once per turn instant - popup : select number of energy counters to spend - check hand for cards with 'deal *x* arcane damage' where x is equal to the number of energy counters spent - show to player and make them select 1 - move the card to banish zone - change effective card type to 'instant'
hero-bravo-flattering-showman:
one big action text that can be activated during the action phase if an action point is available. requires resources or pitch. 

action - cost 2 resources and hero is tapped - popup : select card in arsenal (must be face down) - turn face up , popup : show card to both players - conditional extra effect - check if card has 'crush' - if yes - add 2 effective attack power , add dominate. go again.
hero-briar:
'essence of earth and lightning' is a static ability that we do not need to worry about (it is a deck building restriction)

triggered ability - check log for attack action dealing damage to hero - first time per turn - if yes - create embodiment of earth token.

triggered ability - if non-attack action is played - check log for exactly 1 other non-attack action played in the same turn - if yes - create embodiment of lightning token.
hero-fai:
in preparations for fai - remove 1 phoenix flame from card pool and add it to fai's grave. 

once per turn instant - cost 3 resources - conditional cost reduction - check each chain link for attacking card with type 'draconic' - for each 1/2/3 draconic continuous chainlinks found this way the cost is reduced by 1/2/3 - popup: find phoenix flame cards in graveyard - select 1 - it is added to player's hand.
hero-kayo:
kayo only has 1 weapon zone. because he only has one arm - the other arm was ripped of in the lore. 

triggered ability - whenever the attack power of a card is checked - if it is not on the combat chain - add 1 attack power to the 'effective attack power' before the card is evaluated for other effects. 

triggered ability - check log for discard - check if effective attack power of card is is 6 or greater - if yes - create 'might token' in play on player's board. - this can only create 1 might token per turn.
hero-lyath-goldmane:
lyath hero card starts with a major drawback - this is because he has *5* intellect - every other hero has 4 - effective *base* attack and defense power of all laths cards are divided by 2 and rounded up to the nearest whole number. this is a chaotic ability for sure. 

instant activated ability - cost 2 - tap lyath - the crowd boos you ; create macro - check defending cards for 'action' - for each action add 1 defense power - removed at end of turn. 

triggered ability - whenever 'the crowd boos you' : create a might token on player's board.
hero-arakni-web-of-deceit:
triggered ability - check every attack for 'stealth' - if yes - check opponent for 'marked' or has 'mark' - if yes - add +1 attack power add 'on hit effect - add go again'

conditional extra effect - at the 'beginning of your end phase' - if your opponent has 'mark' or is 'marked' - roll a 6 sided die -  replace player her with corresponding 'agent of chaos'  - you might need to go to fabrary for the agents - 1 = Arakni, Black Widow ; 2= Arakni, Funnel Web ; 3 = Arakni, Orb-weaver ; 4 = Arakni, Redback ; 5 = Arakni, Tarantula ; 6 = Arakni, Trap Door - if you haven't already you'll need to add each one fore me to review individually. the card notes that your life does not change when you 'transform' your hero between agents of chaos.
hero-boltyn:
triggered ability - check log - when 'charge' is resolved - create macro 1 per turn - conditional static effect - check defending card types for 'attack action' - if yes - your active attack gets plus 1 attack power. 

attack reaction - cost requires popup - select 1 card from soul - conditional effect - check if active attack has effective attack power greater than base attack power - if yes - add go again to active attack.
hero-enigma: static ability conditional cost reduction - if  an attack has name 'spectral shield' - reduce the resources required by 1.
